title: Tropical Storm/Typhoon Sinlaku hits Chuuk State
detail: The FSM Disaster Coordination (CDEOC) issued situation report No. 6 on Sinlaku's impact on Chuuk State on 16 April; a later Pacific Island Times report said seven people were killed and thousands left homeless in Chuuk, and FSM said a Compact disaster declaration was approved after a joint FSM-US damage assessment.
attribution: FSM CDEOC situation report (headline only); death toll per Pacific Island Times headline

title: US Indo-Pacific Command reportedly weighs moving planned projects out of Micronesia
detail: PINA reported that US Pacific (Indo-Pacific) Command was considering moving billions of dollars of planned infrastructure out of Micronesia; FSM hosts planned US projects including a Yap airfield upgrade.
